about_blocks.text: Nelson House Medicine Lodge’s Residential Treatment Services operates a 21-bed, non-medical, inpatient, residential treatment program as part of its delivery of the National Native Alcohol and Drug Abuse Program (NNADAP). Residential treatment is for individuals already experiencing alcohol and/or drug addiction, whose life experiences have contributed to unhealthy, addictive and destructive behaviours. These individuals have realized that to heal and become whole again, they require professional assistance to help regain their culture, spirituality and sobriety. Residential Treatment Services are available to non-aborignal people who believe they can benefit from an indigenous approach to healing.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
